reply.emotion: delighted and gentle, smelling something sweet
notes: La flor refers to the bloom of a plant, while planta refers to the whole living organism including roots and leaves.
Do not confuse with harina (flour), which sounds similar in English but refers to baking powder in Spanish.

senses.definition: Parte de la planta que tiene colores bonitos y de donde sale el fruto.

examples.text: La rosa es una flor muy hermosa.
examples.translation: The rose is a very beautiful flower.
examples.emotion: admiring and warm, pointing out something pretty in the garden

senses.definition: Conjunto de los mejores momentos o la mejor edad de la vida.

examples.text: Ella está en la flor de la juventud.
examples.translation: She is in the prime of youth.
examples.emotion: reflective and affectionate, looking back on youth
